General purpose

Balanced CPU-to-memory ratio. Ideal for testing and development, small to medium databases, and low to medium traffic web servers.

Bps v2-series (latest generation)

The Bps v2 VM series are the latest economical virtual machines that provide a low-cost option for workloads that typically run at a low to moderate baseline CPU utilization, but sometimes need to burst to significantly higher CPU utilization when the demand rises. These workloads don’t require the use of the full CPU all the time, but occasionally will need to burst to finish some tasks more quickly. Various applications such as development and test servers, low traffic web servers, small databases, micro services, servers for proof-of-concepts, build servers, and code repositories fit into this model.

This VM series runs on the Ampere® Altra® Arm-based processor.

You can attach Standard SSDs, Standard HDDs, and Premium SSDs disk storage to these VMs. You can also attach Ultra Disk storage based on its regional availability. Disk storage is billed separately from virtual machines. See pricing for disks.

The Dadsv5 VM sizes offer a combination of vCPUs, memory, and temporary storage able to meet the requirements associated with most enterprise workloads, such as small-to-medium databases, low-to-medium traffic web servers, application servers and more.

You can attach Standard SSDs, Standard HDDs, and Premium SSDs disk storage to these VMs. You can also attach Ultra Disk storage based on its regional availability. Disk storage is billed separately from virtual machines. See pricing for disks.

DCesv5-series (available in preview)

The DCesv5-series are general purpose virtual machines running on 4th Generation Intel® Xeon® Scalable processors. These processors are hyper-threaded with a base frequency of 2.1GHz. They offer additional confidentiality and integrity protections by leveraging Intel® Trust Domain Extensions (TDX). Customers will have VM level isolation which has been designed to help remove cloud operators, Azure host, and other Azure infrastructural components from the trusted boundary without additional code modification.

The DCesv5-series VMs have no temporary storage. However, you can attach persistent Premium/Standard SSDs, and Standard HDDs disk storage to these VMs. Disk storage is billed separately from virtual machines. See pricing for disks.

Pricing is not available in the selected region

D2d – D96d v5 (latest generation)

The Ddv5 series virtual machines are based on the 3rd Generation Intel® Xeon® Platinum 8370C (Ice Lake) processor in a hyper-threaded configuration. This custom processor can reach an all core Turbo clock speed of up to 3.5GHz and features Intel® Turbo Boost Technology 2.0, Intel® Advanced Vector Extensions 512 (Intel® AVX-512) and Intel® Deep Learning Boost. The Ddv5 and Ddsv5 virtual machine sizes include high performance, large local SSD storage (up to 3,600 GiB) and provide a better value proposition for most general-purpose workloads compared to the prior generation (e.g., increased scalability and an upgraded CPU class).

The Ddv5 VM sizes offer a combination of vCPUs, memory, and temporary storage able to meet the requirements associated with most enterprise workloads, such as small-to-medium databases, low-to-medium traffic web servers, virtual-desktops, application servers and more.

You can attach Standard SSDs and Standard HDDs disk storage to these VMs. To use Premium SSD or Ultra Disk storage, select Ddsv5 VMs. Disk storage is billed separately from virtual machines. See pricing for disks.

D2lds – D96lds v5 (latest generation with local temporary storage)

The Dldsv5 series virtual machines are based on the 3rd Generation Intel® Xeon® Platinum 8370C (Ice Lake) processor in a hyper-threaded configuration. This custom processor can reach an all-core Turbo clock speed of up to 3.5GHz and features Intel® Turbo Boost Technology 2.0, Intel® Advanced Vector Extensions 512 (Intel® AVX-512) and Intel® Deep Learning Boost.

The Dldsv5 VM sizes provide 2GiBs RAM per vCPU and are optimized for workloads that require less RAM per vCPU than standard VM sizes such as small-to-medium databases, low-to-medium traffic web servers, virtual desktops, application servers, batch processing, analytics and more. These VM sizes are optimal for reducing costs of running non-memory-intensive applications.

The Dldsv5 VM sizes also include local temporary storage for applications that benefit from low latency, high-speed local storage, such as applications that require fast reads/writes to temp storage or temp storage for caches or temporary files. You can also attach Standard SSDs, Standard HDDs, and Premium SSDs for remote disk storage. It is also possible to attach Ultra Disk storage based on its regional availability. Disk storage is billed separately from virtual machines. See pricing for disks

DCsv3-series

The DCsv3 and DCdsv3-series virtual machines run the 3rd Generation Intel® Xeon Scalable (Ice Lake) processor with hyper-threading disabled for a hardened security posture. These VMs are designed to protect the confidentiality and integrity of your data in the cloud. Featuring Intel® SGX (Software Guard Extensions), customers can create private regions of memory, called enclaves, to protect code and data in use. DCsv3 and DCdsv3-series enables customers to up to 1500X larger enclaves than before.

The DCsv3 virtual machine sizes do not have any temporary storage thus lowering the price of entry. You can attach Standard SSDs, and Standard HDDs disk storage to these VMs. Disk storage is billed separately from virtual machines. See pricing for disks.

DCsv3 and DCdsv3-series VM sizes offer a combination of Cores, RAM, EPC, and temporary storage able to meet the requirements associated with most large enterprise workloads.

DCsv2-series

The DCsv2-series virtual machines can help protect the confidentiality and integrity of your data and code while it’s processed in the public cloud. DCsv2-series is ideal for workloads that require smaller EPC (Enclave Page Cache) memory.

FX-series

The FX series virtual machine is a new addition to the F-Series designed for high-frequency compute workloads such as EDA. The FX series VM runs on the Intel® Xeon® 6246R processors in a hyper-threaded configuration. Customers can optionally turn off hyper-thread. The VM features a base frequency of 3.4 GHz, an all-core-turbo (ACT) clock speed of up to 4.0 GHz, and offers a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 21:1 including up to 1TB of memory on the maximum VM size. With the FX series, customers can achieve a significantly faster turnaround time for their EDA backed and frontend applications thus lowering the TCO and achieving faster time to market for their silicon products.

E2pds – E96pds v6 (with local temporary storage)

The Epdsv6-series virtual machines are powered by Azure’s first-generation Cobalt 100 processor, delivering outstanding performance for memory optimized workloads. The Azure Cobalt 100 processor operates at 3.4 GHz and provides an entire physical core for each virtual machine vCPU. These virtual machines offer 8 GiB of memory per vCPU and a wide range of vCPU sizes. These VMs are best suited for memory-intensive scale-out and enterprise workloads, such as relational database servers, large databases, data analytics engines, in-memory caches, and more. Epdsv6-series virtual machines support Standard SSD, Standard HDD, and Premium SSD disk types. You can also attach Ultra Disk storage based on its regional availability. Disk storage is billed separately from virtual machines. For more information, see pricing for disks. Epdsv6-series virtual machines offer up to 96 vCPU, up to 672 GiB of RAM, and up to 5,280 GiB of fast local NVMe temporary storage.

E2bds – E64bds v5 (latest generation)

The new memory optimized Ebdsv5 VM series delivers higher remote storage performance in each VM size compared to Ev5 VM series. The Ebdsv5 VMs offer up to 120,000 IOPS and 4,000 MBps of remote disk storage throughput. They also include up to 512 GiB of RAM and local SSD storage (up to 2,400 GiB).

The Ebdsv5 VMs are based on the 3rd Generation Intel® Xeon® Platinum 8370C (Ice Lake) processor in a hyper-threaded configuration. This custom processor can reach an all-core Turbo clock speed of up to 3.5GHz and features Intel® Turbo Boost Technology 2.0, Intel® Advanced Vector Extensions 512 (Intel® AVX-512), and Intel® Deep Learning Boost.

The increased remote storage performance of the Ebdsv5 VMs is ideal for storage throughput-intensive workloads, such as relational databases and data analytics applications. The Ebdsv5 VMs provide up to 300% increase in remote storage performance compared to prior VM generations and can help consolidate existing workloads on fewer VMs, or on smaller VM sizes while achieving potential cost savings. Please refer to the documentation for additional details.

You can attach Standard SSDs and Standard HDDs disk storage to these VMs in addition to Premium SSDs and Ultra Disk storage. Disk storage is billed separately from virtual machines. Ebdsv5 VMs support NVMe storage interface for all Azure Disk offerings, enabling greater VM-to-disk IOPS and throughput than SCSI protocol. See pricing for disks.

The ECesv5-series are memory optimized virtual machines running on 4th Generation Intel® Xeon® Scalable processors. These processors are hyper-threaded with a base frequency of 2.1GHz. BareMetal Infrastructure (second generation)

The new BareMetal Infrastructure (* formerly known as SAP HANA Large Instances) for SAP/Oracle SKUs are powered by 2nd generation Intel Xeon scalable processors (aka Cascade lake) and Intel Optane DC persistent memory, offering higher performance and lower TCO benefits. The SKUs are offered from 1.5TiB to 24TiB configurations with 2 - 16 sockets and 32 - 896 vCPUs supporting the needs of OLAP and OLTP workloads. With these instances, customers can now take advantage of the innovation behind Intel’s Optane DC Persistent Memory to speed up SAP HANA table loads in the event of a cold start or an instance reboot, offering significantly faster load times.

Constrained vCPUs capable

These new VM sizes are optimized for database workloads like SQL Server that often require high memory, storage, and I/O bandwidth, but not a high CPU core count. They constrain the VM vCPU(s) count and can help reduce the cost of software licensing, all while maintaining the same memory, storage, and I/O bandwidth. The licensing charged for SQL Server will be constrained to the active vCPU(s) count while the compute cost, which includes OS licensing, remains the same one as the original size based on “underlying vCPU(s)”. These new VM sizes allow customer workloads to use the same memory, storage, and I/O bandwidth while optimizing their software licensing cost.

Storage optimized

High disk throughput and IO. Ideal for Big Data, SQL, and NoSQL databases.

L8as – L80as v3 (latest generation)

The Lasv3 VM series features high throughput, low latency, directly mapped local NVMe storage and are based on the 3rd Generation AMD EPYC™ 7763v (Milan) processor in a hyper-threaded configuration. The Lasv3 VMs come in sizes from 8 to 80 vCPU(s) with 8 GiBs of memory per vCPU, and one 1.92TB NVMe SSD per 8 vCPU, with up to 19.2TB (10x1.92TB) available on the L80asv3 instance. Additionally, the Lasv3 VMs provide up to 32 Gbps of networking bandwidth and up to 1400 MB/s of uncached remote disk throughput.

You can attach Standard SSDs, Standard HDDs, Premium SSDs, and Ultra Disks to the Lasv3 VMs based on regional availability. Disk storage is billed separately from the virtual machines. See pricing for disks.

NCads H100 v5 Series

The NCads H100 v5 series virtual machine (VM) is designed and optimized for midrange Generative AI training, Generative AI inference and HPC simulation workloads. The NCads H100 v5 series is powered by NVIDIA H100 NVL GPU and 4th-generation AMD EPYC™ Genoa processors. The VMs feature up to 2 NVIDIA H100 NVL GPUs with 94GB memory each, up to 96 non-multithreaded AMD EPYC Genoa processor cores and 640 GiB of system memory. The VM series is ideal for scenarios including: GPU-accelerated analytics and databases, Batch inferencing with heavy pre and post-processing, model training, Oil and gas reservoir simulation, Machine learning (ML) development, Video processing, AI/ML web services.

NCCads H100 v5 Series

The NCCads H100 v5 series virtual machine (VM) is designed and optimized for applied AI training and batch inference workloads.

The NCCads H100 v5 series is powered by NVIDIA H100 NVL GPU and 4th-generation AMD EPYC™ Genoa processors. The VMs feature an NVIDIA H100 NVL GPUs with 94GB memory each, up to 40 non-multithreaded AMD EPYC™ Genoa processor cores and 320 GiB of system memory.

The VM series is ideal for scenarios including: GPU-accelerated analytics and databases, Batch inferencing with heavy pre- and post-processing, model training, Oil and gas reservoir simulation, Machine learning (ML) development, Video processing, AI/ML web services. These VMs offer additional confidentiality and integrity leveraging the AMD SEV-SNP (Secure Nested Paging) and NVIDIA confidential computing security features. Customers will have VM level and GPU level isolation which has been designed to help remove cloud operators, the Azure host, and other Azure infrastructural components from the trust boundary without additional code modification.

Pricing is not available in the selected region

NCsv2-series

NCsv2 series virtual machines is a new addition to the GPU product family offering the next generation of our popular NC-series machines, powered by NVIDIA Tesla P100 GPUs. Customers can take advantage of these updated GPUs for traditional HPC workloads that will benefit from a performance boost, powering scenarios like reservoir modeling, DNA sequencing, protein analysis, Monte Carlo simulations, and others. These new GPUs can provide more than 2 times the computational performance of the current NC-series. And like our NC series, we offer a configuration with InfiniBand networking for workloads that require fast interconnect, like Oil and Gas, Automotive, and Genomics to also accelerate scaleout capability as well as improved single instance performance. In addition, N-series offers an NC24r configuration that provides a low latency, high-throughput network interface optimized for tightly coupled parallel computing workloads.

NDs-series

NDs-series virtual machines is a new addition to the GPU family specifically designed for the needs of the AI and deep learning workloads offering excellent performance for training and inference. Additionally, the SKU provides access to modern codecs such as AV1 to further improve efficiency for video processing. HC-series

HC-series VMs are optimized for applications driven by dense computation, such as implicit finite element analysis, reservoir simulation, and computational chemistry. HC VMs feature 44 Intel Xeon Platinum 8168 processor cores, 8 GB of RAM per CPU core, and no hyperthreading. HC-series VMs support Intel’s rich ecosystem of software tools such as the Intel Math Kernel Library, and feature an all-cores clock speed greater than 3 GHz for most workloads. HC-series VMs also feature 100 Gb/sec EDR InfiniBand with support for standard Mellanox OFED drivers and all MPI types and versions.
